title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：valley　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 valley 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the farmer ① crossed the valley that no child in the field would have counted, and he said the crossing was the whole of the autumn. The ② valley, meaning the basin itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed uncounted in the book; a valley, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ valley in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ valley at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A valley, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the farmer said the counting is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the valley was the whole of the matter, meaning the shelter and not the basin. The ⑥ valley, meaning the shelter and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; valley, he said, is either something you cross or the only word that means both a basin and a shelter. He said the shelter is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ valley had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ valley of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of counting; valley, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ valley I remember is the basin counted in the almanac, which closed in 1994 and is still counted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ valley, my mother said in 1996, is the only basin that improves by being counted; every valley, she said, is a shelter that has agreed to look like a basin. She said the shelter was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 山谷（指田垄里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 山谷（指那条山谷本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：cross the valley 穿越这一条山谷
D. n. 山谷（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 山谷之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的山谷之事）
F. n. 山谷（指农事历里写到、被清点的那一条）
G. n. 山谷、幽静（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 幽静（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: crossed the valley that no child in the field would have counted
The valley, meaning the basin itself and not the basket
the valley at the far fence
the valley was the whole of the matter
the valley had become a line in an almanac
The valley of the whole thing
A valley, my mother said in 1996

answers.why: cross the valley 意为“穿越这一条山谷”，1987 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯清点的一条山谷做了一遍。
valley 意为“山谷”，指那条山谷本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被清点。
valley 意为“山谷”，指田垄里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
valley 意为“山谷”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
valley 意为“山谷、幽静”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条幽静就是那件事的全部。
valley 意为“幽静”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条山谷，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
valley 意为“山谷”，指农事历里写到、被清点的那一条，到 1992 年这一条成了农事历里的一行。
valley 意为“山谷之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的山谷之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的清点。
valley 意为“山谷”，我记得的是农事历里清点过的那一条，1994 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一条。
valley 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，山谷是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的山谷。

那条山谷，指的是那条山谷本身而不是小小的竹篮，经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被清点。（valley）
